diagnosed: Independently re-confirmed the one real, reproducible mechanical breakage, with two fresh recurrences today; its only correct fix lives entirely in a hook-protected path (.github/workflows/research-agent.yml), so no PR is possible from an unattended CI agent. The research ESCALATION fast-lane remains 100% broken. Scout/coverage-critic request a deep escalation via `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched run's actor is github-actions[bot]. anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 resolves to a newer action build (v3, '__anthropics_claude-code-action_3' in the logs) that gates non-human actors and rejects bot actors unless listed in allowed_bots; no step in research-agent.yml sets it (default = allow no bots). Every escalated research run therefore dies at its claude-code-action step with 'Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use * to allow all bots.' Confirmed firsthand this run from the failed-run log of the NEWEST occurrence: workflow_dispatch run 46155014484 (2026-11-28T14:30Z) failed with that exact error (Actor type: Bot, github-actions; event: workflow_dispatch). The run-list pattern across the last 15 research runs is unambiguous: every `schedule` run carries a human actor and succeeds (e.g. 2026-11-28T07:49Z 46122927888, 2026-11-28T00:02Z 46085762722, 2026-11-27T13:52Z 46010830619); every `workflow_dispatch` (bot) run fails (46155014484 2026-11-28T14:30Z, 46146362489 2026-11-28T12:47Z, 46084096239 2026-11-27T23:43Z, 46007951059 2026-11-27T13:32Z, 45830720452 2026-11-26T13:36Z, 45628931732 2026-11-25T13:57Z, 45522955676 2026-11-25T01:04Z). The `gh workflow run` dispatch itself returns success, so escalate-research.js reports success, masking the failure except as red research runs. OWNER FIX NEEDED (protected .github/workflows/research-agent.yml) — ALREADY TRACKED by OPEN issue #430: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` to the with: block of the two deep-tier claude-code-action@v1 steps (Fable 5 'deep, preferred' and Opus 4.8 'deep fallback'; escalations always pass tier=deep). Per the action's actor validation the matcher lowercases and strips a trailing [bot], so either `github-actions[bot]` or `github-actions` matches the github-actions[bot] actor. Scope to the trusted first-party Actions bot; do NOT use `*` on this public repo (claude-code-action security docs warn an external App could then invoke the action). CAVEAT (documented in #430): setting allowed_bots can move the token out of .git/config into a credential helper, so the deep steps' in-prompt `git push` may lose the checkout@v5-persisted credentials unless `github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` is ALSO added to the two deep steps. Leave the standard scheduled step untouched (it works today).

Could NOT author the fix: this is the unattended Self-repair CI agent (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true/CI=true), so the CI-only scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook fires and BLOCKS any Edit/Write/Bash mutation of .github/workflows/** ('A human must author changes to these files'). Re-confirmed this run: on a self-repair/ branch the Edit adding allowed_bots to research-agent.yml was blocked by the hook (exit 2); branch abandoned, working tree clean. By design an unattended CI agent cannot author protected-path (.github/workflows/**) changes — the hook is a hard safety invariant and was NOT circumvented (no env-var/API/indirect-write workaround attempted) — so no PR is possible and the fix must be applied by a human.

No non-protected fix exists: the breakage is the bot-actor gate on the dispatched run. Any GITHUB_TOKEN-authenticated `gh workflow run`/repository_dispatch produces a Bot actor regardless of event, so changing escalate-research.js cannot make the dispatch a human actor without a new PAT secret + workflow wiring (itself a protected change). The allowed_bots (+github_token) addition to the two deep steps is the correct, minimal fix.

Did NOT add another comment to issue #430 this run: it already carries the complete, verified fix (allowed_bots scoping + the github_token/credential-helper caveat + the actor-matcher confirmation). A per-run 're-confirmed again' comment would be pure noise; the git history of this log is the recurrence timeline (newest confirmed occurrence this run: run 46155014484, 2026-11-28T14:30Z).
